sloka: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वा यक्षराक्षसपन्नगाः ।ते ऽपि गत्वा हि पितरं वरणं रोचयन्ति मे ।। ७.१७.१० ॥
transliteration: tato devāḥ sagandharvā yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ ।te 'pi gatvā hi pitaraṁ varaṇaṁ rocayanti me ।। 7.17.10 ॥

translations.english: While my great-souled father was constantly engaged in the study of the Vedas, I was born as a daughter, manifested from his speech, and was known by the name Vedavati.
